text:
Hannah: Big public thanks to Andre and Lina for the laptop/monitor lifeline today 389
Andre: Oh man, the new hire's laptop bricked 10 min before pairing. Dug out my spare, wiped it, and handed over the mount. Lina did the quick dotfiles sync. Team handoff was silky.
Lina: We also set up a shared tmux session so Marcus could jump in without interrupting the flow. New hire got through their first bugfix and was so happy. :relieved:
Marcus: Shoutout to Facilities too 44d 525 they found a spare 27" monitor in the storage closet and taped a note on it "Hero Monitor". Made the pairing so much nicer.
People-Ops: Love this. We're sending Andre and Lina digital "Mentor Extraordinaire" badges and a $40 bookstore voucher. Also adding this moment to the monthly kudos blurb. :sparkles:
IT-Bot: Incident log: 2026-11-04T09:02:03Z - device failure (new hire machine). 09:05:12Z - spare laptop provisioned by Andre; 09:12:44Z - dotfiles synced by Lina; 09:30:01Z - pair session concluded.
Hannah: The new hire said 'felt like onboarding bootcamp but with kindness'. Small acts, huge retention vibes.
Marcus: Can we make a short "spare kit" checklist and pin it by the storage door? Suggested items: spare laptop, hdmi cable, monitor, power strip, usb-c hub.
Facilities: Will create a labeled bag and stick a laminated checklist inside. We'll also add a quick QR that links to the loan policy.
Andre: If helpful, I can add a one-page "quick-restore" script to the team repo so spares can be prepped faster.
Lina: And I'll volunteer to run a 10-min session on dotfiles sync + important env vars so folks can self-service.
People-Ops: Perfect 44f We'll include the training slot in the onboarding schedule. Also organizing a small thank-you coffee for Andre and Lina at 3pm.
Coffee-Bot: Manual dispense event scheduled: 2026-11-04T15:00:00Z - 2 medium lattes for @Andre and @Lina.
Hannah: Thank you everyone. Feels good to shout out the tiny rescues that keep things moving. :seedling: :heart:
